Improved Smart Ammunition only. Single Shot fires a 3-round burst; with fewer than 3 left it empties the magazine for 2d6. A natural 1 never implodes. Set its mode when you get it, locked for a month (or until its biometric owner dies): Puppy-Loving Pacifist (+2 to Leg and Held Item Aimed Shots, no head shots) or Stone Cold Killer (+2 to head Aimed Shots, no Leg or Held Item shots). Its talking onboard assistant has opinions: the GM may have it fire on its own, put you at −2 for a fight, or chat loudly during a sneak.

Class: Iconic EQ Heavy Pistol • SMART
Range table: Pistol
Damage: 3d6
Alt. fire: Autofire (Machine Pistol 4), Suppressive Fire
Built-in: Auto-Compensator, Biometric Lock, Pistol Autosear, Smart Rebuild (w/ Advanced Smartlink)
Fabrication: DV29 - 5,000eb - 1 Month
